basis: Conservative engineering planning envelope; not measured candidate peak, not an upstream exact minimum
nested_Chromium_parallelism: Must independently enforce single job; outer cmake --parallel alone is insufficient
memory_limit_caveat: Readiness policy, not measured peak guarantee; linking peak unknown; stop if pressure grows
swap_policy: No swap creation/resizing/configuration; do not count exhausted swap as capacity
cache_policy: No compiler cache for first build; no duplicate monolithic Qt source; only selected source modules; reuse only exact verified inputs
build_mode: Release, no developer build, no tests/examples/debug information for third-party Qt; preserve required security checks
